author: Cleo Abram
description:
Scientists recently completed a phase 3 clinical trial of a new vaccine for a type of skin cancer called Melanoma. The results are really stunning showing that when paired with another drug it can reduce the chances of cancer recurring or spreading to other parts of the body. This is a HUGE deal that could completely change how we think about how we treat cancer in the future. 

The biggest deal about this new cancer vaccine? It can be personally made for you. 

To find out more, subscribe! 

#vaccines #healthcare #cancer #science #animation
title: They Created A Skin Cancer Vaccine
